description: This file declares internal API functions for the Slap Object Record (Oro) component, including reference counting, access control, and matching functions, for use within the SLAP architecture.

methods.name: SlapOroGetRef
methods.description: Returns the reference count of the Slap Object Record.

methods.name: SlapOroIncRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count of the Slap Object Record.

methods.name: SlapOroDecRef
methods.description: Decrements the reference count of the Slap Object Record.

methods.name: SlapOroAcqAccess
methods.description: Acquires access to the Slap Object Record, possibly implementing a lock.

methods.name: SlapOroRelAccess
methods.description: Releases access to the Slap Object Record, possibly unlocking.

methods.name: SlapOroMatch1
methods.description: Determines if the object matches a given container and instance ID.

methods.name: SlapOroMatch2
methods.description: Determines if the object matches a container and service component.
